aviation_incidents.headline: NTSB在佛州墜機現場外尋獲Learjet 60左升降舵大部分殘骸 證實機尾部件空中分離
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）於11月3日表示，調查人員在佛州墜機地點外1.3至3.8英里處尋獲三塊Learjet 60左升降舵殘骸，合計約為該升降舵大部分，證實部分機尾在撞擊地面前已於空中分離。飛機於2026年11月1日在格林埃克斯附近墜毀，機上9人全數罹難；NTSB尚未判定升降舵分離時間或其是否導致失控。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: NTSB finds most of Learjet 60's left elevator near Florida crash site, confirming part of the tail separated in flight
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The NTSB said at a Nov. 3 briefing that investigators recovered three pieces of the Learjet 60's left elevator 1.3 to 3.8 miles from the Florida crash site; together, they account for most of the elevator and confirm that part of the tail separated in flight. The jet crashed near Greenacres, Florida, on Nov. 1, 2026, killing all nine aboard. The NTSB has not determined when the elevator separated or whether its loss contributed to the loss of control.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航前3季營收與淨利雙創歷年同期新高 客運及貨運收入同步寫紀錄
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華航前3季合併營收1,859.4億元、每股盈餘1.8元，營收與淨利均創歷年同期新高，客運及貨運收入也創紀錄；暑期旅遊需求推升客運，AI伺服器與半導體設備貨源帶動貨運，華航預期第4季貨運需求續強。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines sets first-nine-month records for revenue and net profit, with passenger and cargo revenue also hitting highs
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines reported consolidated revenue of NT$185.94 billion and EPS of NT$1.8 for the first nine months, with revenue and net profit at record levels for the period and passenger and cargo revenue also setting records. Summer travel demand boosted passenger revenue, while AI servers and semiconductor equipment supported cargo; the airline expects the year-end shopping season to sustain strong cargo demand in the fourth quarter.

international_aviation.headline: 美司法部請求法院沒收中國註冊灣流G550 檢方稱該機未獲許可飛往伊朗並停留6天
international_aviation.summary: 美國司法部請求加州聯邦法院准許沒收2026年5月24日在安克拉治扣押的中國註冊灣流G550。檢方稱該機2024年12月13日飛抵德黑蘭、12月19日返回北京，停留6天，超過當時財政部72小時一般許可期限，且未取得飛往伊朗所需的美國出口管制許可；法院尚未裁定，司法部要求在裁定前給予權利主張者提出異議的機會。
international_aviation.headline_en: US seeks forfeiture of Chinese-registered Gulfstream G550 over alleged unlicensed Iran trip and six-day stay
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Justice Department asked a California federal court to grant civil forfeiture of a Chinese-registered Gulfstream G550 seized in Anchorage on May 24, 2026. Prosecutors say it flew from Beijing to Tehran on December 13, 2024, returning to Beijing on December 19 after a six-day stay; the stay exceeded the Treasury's 72-hour general-license limit, and the flight lacked required US export-control approval. The court has not ruled, and DOJ asked that anyone claiming an interest in the aircraft be given a chance to contest forfeiture.

international_aviation.headline: 波音Everett新產線推出首架737 MAX 10 普吉特灣737產能可增25%
international_aviation.summary: 波音於2026年10月26日在Everett北產線推出首架737 MAX 10，預定交付西捷航空。新線空間較大，737 MAX 10可連續組裝，不必像在Renton廠一樣與較短機型錯位排產，普吉特灣地區737總產能因此提升25%。美國聯邦航空總署於2026年10月20日核發737 MAX 10飛行平台修訂型別檢定證，但波音仍須取得該署對生產檢定證的修訂核准，西捷航空初期交付將暫緩。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing rolls out first Everett-built 737 MAX 10, bringing a 25% Puget Sound 737 capacity boost
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing rolled out the first 737 MAX 10 assembled on Everett's North Line on October 26, 2026, with the aircraft intended for WestJet. The larger line lets the long-fuselage jet move nose-to-tail rather than requiring the staggered sequencing used at space-constrained Renton, lifting total 737 capacity in the Puget Sound region by 25%. The FAA issued an amended type certificate for the flight platform on October 20, but Boeing still needs an amended production certificate; initial WestJet deliveries remain paused until that amendment is issued.

international_aviation.headline: 北約開設反無人機市集 盟國可免另行招標從16套預選方案中採購 Alta Ares取得6個標案
international_aviation.summary: 北約於2026年11月5日啟用反無人機市集，盟國可免另行招標，直接從16套預選方案目錄下單；5家廠商入選，法國Alta Ares取得6個標案，涵蓋區域與邊境防護。
international_aviation.headline_en: NATO opens counter-drone marketplace for 16 systems without a separate tender as Alta Ares wins six lots
international_aviation.summary_en: NATO launched the marketplace on November 5, 2026, enabling allies to order directly from a catalog of 16 preselected systems without a separate tender. Five suppliers were selected, and French company Alta Ares secured six lots covering area and border protection.
